name: Battery Replacement
summary: Battery location (trunk, right side), mandatory battery registration, terminal order and general removal flow are corroborated for E9x. No BMW OE battery part number, no OE Ah/CCA/AGM spec for this VIN, no torque values and no E90-specific vent-hose evidence were found. Procedure can be published as a general flow with a registration warning, but the battery spec must come from the owner's existing battery label or BMW ETK/dealer lookup. The BMW training document (ST502 E90 Voltage Supply) could not be retrieved (fetch blocked), so no OEM-document corroboration was obtained.
variantDependencies: Engine N52B30 vs N51B30: not confirmed from VIN; battery guidance found does not distinguish them.
Battery type (flooded vs AGM) and Ah rating: depends on build/options and any prior replacement; coding to AGM may be needed if type changes (1addicts E82 thread, BimmerForums thread).
Vent hose routing/position and battery tray fit: only evidenced on E82/E70 threads; E90 sedan not confirmed. Vent connection positions can differ between battery brands (E70 thread).
Registration tool: dealer ISTA, INPA/NCS Expert, BimmerLink/BimmerCode, or professional scan tools (threads); capability depends on tool chosen.

tools.item: 10 mm socket + ratchet (terminal clamp nuts, bracket nuts)
13 mm socket (listed by YouCanic; 1addicts E82 author says not needed on his car)
Socket extension (hold-down bolt on some cars; E82 thread)
Flat screwdriver (release clips on positive power box; E82 thread)
Scan tool capable of BMW battery registration (BimmerLink/INPA/ISTA/Autel etc.)

parts.item: Battery hold-down (URO 61217566618, aftermarket cross-ref listed for 325i/328i)
Negative cable with IBS (Hella 61127616200, listed 325i/328i/330i; fitment to this VIN unverified)
Positive battery lead (Genuine BMW 61129205520, listed 328i/328i xDrive/328xi) - only if cable damaged

specs.value: YouCanic lists H8; also says minimum H6/L3/Group 48 with >=570 CCA; gearshifters says H6, H7 or H8 without picking one
Forum posts: 90 Ah flooded (720 CCA) original on an unspecified car; 80 Ah/640 CCA on an E82; E70 original 100 Ah. Not tied to this VIN.
Yes; skipping lets alternator charge at old battery's profile, shortening battery life

steps.title: Prepare
steps.instruction: Switch ignition off and keep the key away from the ignition/cabin range during the work; test charging system first if the battery fault is not confirmed; photograph the cable and hose layout.

steps.title: Open the trunk battery area
steps.instruction: Remove the right-side trunk trim cover and the panel over the battery.

steps.title: Disconnect negative first, then positive
steps.instruction: Loosen and remove the negative clamp, then the positive; keep metal tools from bridging terminals or touching body metal.

steps.title: Release vent hose and positive power box (if fitted)
steps.instruction: Detach the vent hose near the positive side and lift off the positive terminal power box after unclipping it.
warnings: Evidence is from an E82 thread; E90 sedan layout not confirmed.

steps.title: Remove hold-down and lift out battery
steps.instruction: Remove the hold-down plate/bracket and lift the battery straight out.
warnings: Battery is heavy; lift with legs.

steps.title: Clean and install
steps.instruction: Clean terminal clamps, seat the new battery against the front lip, move the vent hose to the new battery's vent port as needed, refit hold-down.
warnings: Vent port positions can differ between batteries (E70 thread).

steps.title: Reconnect positive then negative
steps.instruction: Connect positive, refit its cover/power box, then negative; coat posts with a protectant.

steps.title: Register battery with the car
steps.instruction: Using a BMW-capable tool, register the new battery (and set AGM/flooded type and Ah if the tool/coding supports it).
warnings: Do not skip; do not claim a specific tool menu path (E70 INPA path is not E90-verified).

steps.title: Post-install checks
steps.instruction: Start the engine; YouCanic advises turning the steering wheel lock to lock a few times to reset the steering angle/DSC warnings. Check for dash faults.
warnings: Elcuerpo3 case (BimmerForums, 2006 325i) showed IBS ground fault lights after a swap; fault-check if lights persist.

steps.title: Torque values for terminals/hold-down
steps.instruction: No sourced torque; tighten snug without over-torquing lead posts.

safety: Eye protection and gloves; battery acid and hydrogen gas.
Disconnect negative first; never let a tool bridge terminals.
Keep the vent hose connected so gas vents outside (general principle; E90 routing unverified).
